label: Gulf War Illness: Neurological Impacts, Pathophysiological Insights, and Therapeutic Prospects.
summary: Gulf War Illness (GWI) is a chronic, multi-system condition affecting a substantial proportion of veterans deployed during the 1990-1991 Gulf War. Neurological complications, including cognitive impairment, musculoskeletal pain, fatigue, depression, and migraine, represent a major clinical burden.
